title: Native date and time inputs with limits
when: The user wants fields to pick a date, a time or a date range, such as a booking, delivery date or appointment.
prompt:
Goal: Native date and time controls with correct limits, a working range rule and no time zone off by one bugs.
Steps:
1. Use <input type="date">, type="time" or type="datetime-local", each with a <label> and an example of the expected value in the hint.
2. Set min and max as YYYY-MM-DD built from local parts (getFullYear, getMonth + 1, getDate), not from toISOString, which is UTC.
3. Time slots: step="900" for 15 minutes, with min and max for opening hours.
4. Range: two date fields in a <fieldset> (Check in, Check out); on change of the start, set end.min to it and clear an earlier end.
5. Parse values with new Date(y, m - 1, d) and show the choice back with Intl.DateTimeFormat in the hint.
Quality bar:
- Past dates are blocked when the task needs it.
- Errors name the allowed range.
- Values are submitted in ISO form.
Pitfalls:
- new Date("2026-10-17"), which parses as UTC and can show the previous day.
- Building a custom calendar grid nobody asked for.
- Text fields with a date mask.
Verify:
- [ ] Every date and time field has a label.
- [ ] min and max are set from local time.
- [ ] The end date cannot be before the start.
- [ ] The formatted echo matches the choice.
Output: Field markup in the form and dates.js for limits and the range rule.

examples.input: campos de data de entrada e saida para reserva
examples.output: fieldset with Check in and Check out date inputs, min today in local time, end.min follows start
